title: Judge Gift Cards 2017: card flavor text

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: An angel who emerged from the Helvault, freed from her prison.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: A silver monolith that imprisoned Avacyn, shattered by an explosion.

entities.name: Jingzhou
entities.description: A province that was the fulcrum of the three kingdoms, coveted and controlled at times by the Wu, the Shu, and the Wei.

entities.name: Wu
entities.description: One of the three kingdoms that coveted and controlled Jingzhou.

entities.name: Shu
entities.description: One of the three kingdoms that coveted and controlled Jingzhou.

entities.name: Wei
entities.description: One of the three kingdoms that coveted and controlled Jingzhou.

entities.name: Gaddock Teeg
entities.description: A figure of such great wisdom and spirit that those who meet him describe him as a giant of a man.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: A figure Malcator wishes to show that progress doesn't always need teeth or claws.

entities.name: Malcator, Executor of Synthesis
entities.description: The Executor of Synthesis, who speaks of showing Vorinclex a different kind of progress.

entities.name: Pendelhaven
entities.description: A place whose limbs extend as far as the meek roam and reach as high as they strive.
